notes.title: 🏚️ Real Estate Simulator 2 Announced - Updated Mechanics and Visual!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to officially announce Real Estate Simulator 2 - a bold step forward in hands-on property management and renovation!
[/p][p]This isn’t just a sequel. We’ve reimagined the entire experience with updated mechanics, a visual overhaul, and a semi-open city to explore. Buy rundown apartments, clean and renovate them with your own hands, furnish to impress, and flip for profit - now with no loading screens between locations.
[/p][p]Drive your own vehicle to deliver furniture, manage projects across a living world with a dynamic day/night cycle, and respond to shifting market trends. Everything has been upgraded - from the way you interact with each room to how the city reacts to your business moves.
[/p][p]From small studios to luxury lofts, every choice matters. With new systems, smoother controls, and better visuals, Real Estate Simulator 2 puts you in full control of your empire.

💼 Wishlist now and be the first to turn ruins into riches: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743420/Real_Estate_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Exciting Update for Real Estate Simulator: New Content, Features, and Fixes!
notes.content:
Dear Real Estate Moguls,

An exciting new update for Real Estate Simulator has arrived, packed with new features, content, and important fixes! Let’s take a closer look at what’s new in this update:

🧹 Watch Out for the Office Intruder!
A new, quirky element has been added to spice up your real estate adventures - a homeless character will occasionally visit your office, scaring off clients. Use the new bat tool to deal with this unexpected guest and keep your business running smoothly.

🏠 Decorate Like Never Before
• 9 new decorative items have been added to help you customize your properties and make them more appealing to buyers.
• 2 new flooring options are now available to add style and variety to your properties.

🚫 Placement Limits for Items
To maintain balance, we’ve introduced a limit on the number of identical items that can be placed in each property.

🎮 Controller Navigation Fixes
We’ve improved navigation with gamepads, ensuring smoother item switching in the shop and when navigating properties during client interactions or in the computer interface.

📋 Bug Fixes and Improvements
• Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented the pause menu from opening.
• Corrected the display of the "cart full" notification to ensure it appears at the right time.
• Missing localization has been added, so the game now feels complete in all supported languages.

This update is packed with exciting additions and adjustments based on your feedback. Your input has been crucial in shaping these changes, and we’re committed to continuing to improve your experience.

Jump back into Real Estate Simulator today to explore the new features, fight off intruders, and make your properties stand out with the latest decor options. Let us know what you think - we’d love to hear from you!

Thank you for your support,
The Real Estate Simulator Team

notes.title: Big Changes Ahead for REAL ESTATE Simulator – Updates Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’re excited to announce that development on REAL ESTATE Simulator is back in full swing! After a brief period of planning and adjustments, the team is now hard at work, and we can’t wait to bring you the upcoming updates!

We’ve already started addressing key issues, and bug fixes are actively being implemented to improve your gameplay experience. But that’s not all—new content and exciting additions are on the way, designed to make your real estate empire even more dynamic and engaging. We’re focused on delivering the features and improvements that you’ve been asking for, so you can expect the game to continue evolving.

We want to express our sincere thanks for all of your valuable feedback. Your insights have been crucial in helping us prioritize what matters most to our community. We’re committed to continuing to listen to your thoughts and making improvements based on your feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates coming your way soon - we’re eager to share the latest developments with you!

Thank you for your continued support, and as always, we truly appreciate everything you do. Let’s continue building that real estate empire together!

Best regards,
The REAL ESTATE Simulator Team

notes.title: New Bug Fix Update for Real Estate Simulator is available now!
notes.content:
Dear Valued Gaming Community,
We’re thrilled to unveil the latest update for Real Estate Simulator, all thanks to your invaluable feedback and support! This update is dedicated to addressing various bugs that have been affecting your gaming experience.
Here’s a glimpse of what’s included:
- Bug fixes addressing issues with item transformations, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience without any unexpected outcomes.
- Enhanced AI trading mechanics, enriching your in-game transactions with greater realism and immersion.
- Added small features like mouse inversion.
We extend a heartfelt thank you for your continuous feedback, comments, and unwavering support. Your input fuels our commitment to refining the game for everyone. Please continue to share your thoughts, and rest assured, we’ll take them into consideration for future updates!
Thank you for being part of our journey and for contributing to making Real Estate Simulator an even more incredible experience!

notes.title: REAL ESTATE Simulator
notes.content:
Embark on an exhilarating journey to build your real estate empire in "Real Estate Simulator," a deep and dynamic business simulation game. Begin as a small-time property investor and strategize your way to become a tycoon in the cutthroat world of real estate. Navigate market trends, negotiate deals, and outsmart competitors in this immersive simulation experience.

🤝 Interactive NPC Negotiations: Engage with a range of NPC clients, from cautious first-time buyers to wealthy investors. Understand their needs, negotiate terms, and close deals that shape your path to success.

🏗️ Property Development and Management: Purchase, renovate, and sell properties across the city. From cheap living areas to luxury skyscrapers, each property brings unique challenges and opportunities.

🎮 Intuitive Controls and UI: Whether you're a seasoned tycoon or new to business sims, intuitive controls and a clear user interface make managing your empire accessible and enjoyable.

🌟 Unique Challenges and Achievements: From market crashes to VIP clients, face unique challenges that test your strategic prowess. Unlock achievements and make your mark in the world of real estate.
